m509153.notes: HISTORIC photo (1959), grainy black-and-white print, Hualien, in front of the old station on 黑金通. The shop name appears twice: the ground-floor fascia read RIGHT TO LEFT (board order 香 乾 郭) and a vertical sign at the right corner. The shop is still trading under this name at the same site per the source, so it is accepted. Two small lines left of the fascia are illegible. Distractors: 'GOLDEN DRAGON HOTEL' and 金龍大旅社 (right to left) on the upper floors, 國泰大旅社 at left, a partial '...運輸社' sign at lower left.

m509233.notes: HISTORIC photo (1951): street-name board on two posts beside a house that collapsed in the 1951 Hualien earthquake, Zhongzheng Road, Hualien City. The road still exists under this name. Zhuyin is printed above the characters; tone marks are too faint to confirm, so they are left out (source says ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨˋ). Large handwritten white caption across the bottom of the print ('瓦屋須如之倒也 / 因為頂重腳輕也故' roughly) is a later annotation and a distractor. The query is ambiguous nationwide; it needs a Hualien City bias.
